passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R32 · Document 1
passages.text:
Career Skills Webinar Series

July 8 — Writing Effective Résumés
July 15 — Preparing for Video Interviews
July 22 — Negotiating a Job Offer

Each live webinar begins at 7 P.M. and lasts approximately seventy-five minutes. Registration is free, but participants must sign up separately for each session. Recordings will be available to registered participants for seven days after each webinar.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R21 · Document 1
passages.text:
Oak Street Bicycle Repair

Spring Tune-Up Special — $39
Service includes brake adjustment, tire inspection, chain cleaning, and a safety check. Bicycles dropped off before noon are usually ready by 5 P.M. the same day. The offer is valid through April 30 and does not include replacement parts. Appointments are recommended on Saturdays.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R13 · Document 1
passages.text:
ONLINE NOTICE
Due to road construction, City Bus Route 18 will not stop at Central Market from July 3 through July 7. Passengers should use the temporary stop on Oak Street, one block east of the market.

TEXT MESSAGE
Mia: I was going to take Route 18 to meet you at Central Market tomorrow, but the stop is closed.
Jon: Get off at the temporary Oak Street stop. I'll meet you there at 1:15. It's next to a pharmacy.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R78 · Document 1
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 1 — FACILITY BULLETIN

The Riverside distribution center will test battery-powered delivery carts from October 6 through October 31. During the trial, charging electricity will be measured separately from the building's regular use. Supervisors should upload weekly distance totals every Monday. The sustainability team will compare energy use per kilometer with the center's current diesel carts before deciding whether to expand the program.

DOCUMENT 2 — MESSAGE THREAD

Ari: Monday's distance report shows only 420 kilometers, but the route dashboard shows 510.
Leah: The report excludes the two carts assigned to driver training. Their chargers are connected to the regular building meter, not the trial meter.
Ari: Then the energy-per-kilometer result could look worse than it really is.
Leah: Agreed. I'll add the training distance in a separate note and flag the meter setup for the sustainability team.

passages.title: Supplier contact change · Document 1
passages.text:
NOTICE TO CUSTOMERS
From July 1, routine order queries should go to our shared service address rather than an individual salesperson. Existing orders keep their reference numbers and agreed delivery dates. Urgent delivery-day problems can still be reported to dispatch by phone. The change is intended to prevent queries being missed when an employee is absent; it does not require customers to open a new trading account.

passages.title: Group ticket name changes · Document 1
passages.text:
GROUP BOOKINGS
You may change the names on unused group tickets until noon on the day before the event. The change does not increase the number of places and does not move the booking to a different date. Discount eligibility must still be met by the replacement attendee. Send the booking reference and revised list together; separate messages for each name can delay processing. Used tickets cannot be transferred retrospectively.

passages.title: Library reading-space rules · Document 1
passages.text:
QUIET STUDY AREA
The upper reading room is reserved for individual quiet study. Short online calls should be taken in the bookable booths on the lower floor, even when headphones are used. A booth booking is limited to one hour when others are waiting. Bags may be left beside your seat during a brief break, but doing so does not reserve an empty desk all day. Staff may clear unattended desks after the posted limit.

passages.title: Reusable cup survey · Document 1
passages.text:
CUSTOMER NOTICE
Our reusable-cup trial is being extended for two weeks. Return rates improved after we added an evening collection point, but the trial has not yet covered a full holiday period. We will collect more data before deciding on permanent arrangements. Deposits remain unchanged during the extension. Customers may return a cup at either collection point regardless of where it was borrowed, provided the cup belongs to this program.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R57 · Document 1
passages.text:
Memo

To: Regional Sales Staff
From: Marco Ruiz, Sales Director
Subject: Customer Visit Notes

Starting next quarter, sales representatives should enter customer visit notes into the client portal within two business days of each visit. The notes should include the customer's current goal, any concern discussed, and the next action promised by our team. Please do not include personal details that are unrelated to the customer's business needs.

The change is intended to help service teams respond more consistently when a representative is unavailable. It will also allow managers to identify common concerns across regions. Representatives who already keep private notes may continue to do so, but the portal entry will be considered the official record.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R82 · Document 1
passages.text:
Dear Mr. Novak,

Thank you for asking about the delay in your equipment order. Our shipping team has confirmed that the barcode scanner and charging stand left our warehouse on Tuesday. However, the protective cases were held for an additional quality check because a supplier reported a packaging issue. Rather than sending a partial shipment, we will combine all three items and upgrade the delivery service at no extra cost. You will receive a new tracking number as soon as the cases pass inspection.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R35 · Document 1
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Mei Lin, Event Coordinator
To: Rafael Ortiz, Harbor Display Rentals
Subject: Riverside Trade Fair Setup

Mr. Ortiz,
Our booth area at the Riverside Trade Fair will be available one day earlier than expected. Could the six modular display tables be delivered on Tuesday afternoon instead of Wednesday morning? The catalog stands can still arrive on Wednesday. Please let me know if changing the table delivery would affect the installation fee.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R35 · Document 2
passages.text:
TEXT MESSAGE
Rafael Ortiz: Tuesday delivery is possible. Because our crew is already scheduled nearby that afternoon, there will be no additional fee. However, the catalog stands are stored at a different warehouse and cannot be delivered until Wednesday.
Mei Lin: That works. Please send the revised delivery note to procurement.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R35 · Document 3
passages.text:

Client: BrightPath Training
Items: 6 modular display tables, 4 catalog stands
Delivery: Tables Tuesday 3:00 P.M.; catalog stands Wednesday 9:30 A.M.
Installation fee: Included
Special note: Tables must be placed along the north wall before carpet installation begins.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R63 · Document 1
passages.text:
Invoice Note

Invoice #8842 includes the annual software subscription for three departments: Sales, Accounting, and Customer Support. The subscription begins on July 1 and includes unlimited online training but does not include on-site workshops. Payment is due within thirty days.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R63 · Document 2
passages.text:

Subject: Invoice #8842

We approved the subscription fee, but the cost center listed on the invoice is outdated. Please replace cost center 41-A with 47-C before we process payment. Also, our Customer Support team would like to schedule online training during the second week of July. Please confirm whether the training sessions need to be reserved in advance.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R104 · Document 1
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 1 - FACILITY MONITORING AGREEMENT

Contract term: July 1-June 30
Annual base fee: $14,400, billed in four equal quarterly payments
Renewal: The agreement renews automatically for twelve months unless either party provides written notice at least forty-five days before June 30.
Additional locations: $250 per location per month, beginning with the first full month after activation
Support: Requests received during business hours receive a response within four business hours. After-hours emergency service is billed separately.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R104 · Document 2

From: Elena Ruiz
To: Facility Monitoring Services

We plan to continue the agreement for another year. Two new branches are scheduled for activation on July 15. Please confirm when charges for those locations will begin and whether the base service will remain on the quarterly billing schedule.

passages.title: Course reimbursement timing · Document 1
passages.text:
LEARNING FUND
Approved assessed courses are reimbursed at 75 percent of the fee, up to$300 per course. Books and travel are excluded. Staff must obtain approval before enrollment and submit proof of passing within thirty days of the result. Attendance alone is not proof of passing.

passages.title: Course reimbursement timing · Document 2
passages.text:
From: Malik Chen
I received approval on April 2 and enrolled on April 5 in the data-visualization course. The fee was$360 plus$40 for a book. My passing result was issued on May 10. I plan to submit the form on June 5. Could you confirm what evidence and amount I should include?

passages.title: Course reimbursement timing · Document 3
passages.text:
To: Malik Chen
Please attach the fee receipt and the provider statement showing your passing result. Your approval record is already on file. Exclude the book cost from the claim. June 5 is within the stated submission window. The same funding rate applies; the maximum is a cap, not an automatic payment.
